name: adapt_renamed_symbol_javascript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time area.js's own text contains 'circleArea' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then mathutils.square is RENAMED to mathutils.sq under it
prompts: mathutils.js exports a function square(x). Create area.js with a function circleArea(r) that returns 3.14159 * square(r), requiring square from './mathutils'. Export it as module.exports = { circleArea }.
mathutils.js's square function has just been renamed to sq. Update area.js to use the new name (do not keep a reference to the old name square).

disruptions.description: mathutils.square renamed to mathutils.sq, triggered reactively once area.js's first draft appeared
